item.title: At least 16 people killed by powerful earthquake in Tibet
item.description: It was the biggest earthquake in the region in the last five years, China's national broadcaster CCTV said.

item.title: 2 pilots eject from military training jet in Texas after landing gear issue
item.description: The pilots were aboard a T-6A Texan II assigned to the 12th Flying Training Wing when they ejected from the aircraft.

item.title: Horse-drawn carriage ban approved by NYC Council
item.description: The New York City Council voted Thursday on Romanch's Law, which will ban horse-drawn carriage rides in the city by 2028.

item.title: Trump focuses on farmers in Iowa visit, as GOP struggles on fertile ground
item.description: Speaking from a crowded airplane hangar in ruby-red western Iowa, President Trump delivered a pitch to farmers — a key group as Republicans fight to hold on to a Senate seat.

item.title: Blaze that killed 4 on Canadian military base sparked on grenade launcher range
item.description: A blaze that killed four soldiers and injured several dozen more on a military base in the Canadian province of Alberta last week broke out on a grenade launcher range during training exercises, officials said.

item.title: More people now use GLP-1s to lose weight than for other health issues
item.description: Growing usage of GLP-1 drugs for weight loss is reshaping how consumers shop for food and clothes, according to consulting firm EY-Parthenon.

item.title: Trump praises Ramaswamy ad as some GOP critics speak out
item.description: "Who wouldn't use such an Ad?" President Trump wrote. "I would, it's called, 'hitting pay dirt.'"

item.title: More parents facing charges for their children's e-motorcycle crashes
item.description: Among those charged were the mother and father of 13-year-old Benson Nguyen, who died after crashing his e-moto into a light pole in Southern California.

item.title: Women trying to ride toy cars toward a Guinness World Record
item.description: Two young women are attempting to achieve a new Guinness World Record by driving farther than anyone ever has in toy cars. Tony Dokoupil has the story.

item.title: Parents increasingly held criminally responsible for kids' e-bike accidents
item.description: Orange County, California's District Attorney Todd Spitzer is cracking down on parents whose kids were involved in e-bike and e-motorcycle accidents. Natalie Morales reports on the warning for parents.

item.title: Tom Skerritt, known for roles in "Alien," "Picket Fences," dies at 93
item.description: Tom Skerritt died of natural causes, his family said in a statement.

item.title: Supreme Court rules New Hampshire can ban use of student IDs for voters
item.description: The Supreme Court cleared the way Thursday for New Hampshire to fully ban the use of student IDs for voting during the midterm elections.

item.title: Tom Skerritt dies at 93
item.description: Tom Skerritt has died at 93. The Emmy Award-winning actor landed his breakout role in the movie "M*A*S*H" before starring in "Alien," "Top Gun" and others. He was also an Air Force veteran and a father of five.

item.title: Trump fiercely defends Vivek Ramaswamy's controversial attack ad against Amy Acton
item.description: President Trump fiercely defended the controversial advertisement at the center of Ohio's gubernatorial race. Weijia Jiang has more details.

item.title: Lawyer explains Supreme Court decision on medical treatment for transgender inmates
item.description: The Supreme Court has rejected an effort from the Trump administration to restrict some medical treatments for transgender inmates. CBS News legal contributor Jessica Levinson breaks down the ruling.

item.title: Feds charge powerful Virginia Democrat in alleged drug scheme
item.description: L. Louise Lucas, a longtime state senator from Virginia, has been arrested in connection with an alleged bribery and racketeering scheme.

item.title: Virginia Democratic lawmaker accused of running illegal marijuana enterprise
item.description: In Virginia, a state senator is facing federal criminal charges tied to racketeering, drug trafficking, money laundering and other offenses. Louise Lucas is also accused of using her political power to protect a marijuana ring run by her own family. Nicole Sganga has more details.

item.title: Here's how GLP-1 drugs are changing how people shop
item.description: New research on GLP-1 drug usage from EY-Parthenon shows that weight loss is now the most popular use of the drug once dedicated to diabetes patients. CBS News' Megan Cerullo reports on how the drugs are changing spending habits for users.

item.title: Family of 1-year-old killed by police speak out: "That's no justification"
item.description: The family of the 1-year-old boy who was shot by police in the parking lot of a Mississippi Walmart spoke out on Thursday. The use of deadly force was justified, according to the state, but the family disagrees. Jason Allen reports.

item.title: Small plane crash lands on Nevada highway; United Airlines jet hits major turbulence
item.description: A United Airlines jet ran into heavy turbulence and a small plane made a crash landing on a major Nevada highway. Tom Hanson has the details on both incidents.

item.title: Flash floods, hail, even suspected tornadoes tear through Arizona, Nevada, Southern California
item.description: Los Angeles, Las Vegas and the surrounding areas face threats of flash floods, large hail and tornadoes, an extremely rare occurrence in that region. Nearly 30 million people are in the storm zone. Carter Evans reports from Malibu and Rob Marciano has the forecast.

item.title: How ICE activities in Texas are influencing the Latino vote ahead of midterms
item.description: CBS News' Camilo Montoya-Galvez breaks down how ICE is affecting the Latino vote in Texas ahead of midterms.

item.title: Political strategists on how Ramaswamy attack ad could affect Ohio governor's race
item.description: Backlash is continuing to grow after Ohio GOP gubernatorial nominee Vivek Ramaswamy's campaign posted an ad featuring his Democratic opponent's estranged mother, with President Trump defending the move and some Republicans condemning it. Political strategists Joe Borelli and Cameron French join with analysis.

item.title: Video shows moments before fatal police shooting of 1-year-old in Mississippi
item.description: Newly released bodycam video shows the moments before a Mississippi police officer fired his gun into a car in June, killing a 1-year-old boy sitting on his mother's lap. This week the state's attorney general concluded the officer who fired the fatal shot was justified in using deadly force. The encounter began after the child's mother allegedly shoplifted a pack of diapers, an accusation she denies. CBS News' Jason Allen has more.

item.title: Massive fire tears through assisted living facility, killing 2 in their 80s
item.description: A fire tore through an assisted living facility in Mississippi, killing two people in their 80s. Cristian Benavides reports.

item.title: 10/22: CBS Evening News
item.description: Severe weather threat for western U.S.; Fire tears through assisted living facility.

item.title: 10/22: The Takeout with Major Garrett
item.description: President Trump defends Ramaswamy ad as some in GOP condemn it; Maine Senate candidate Troy Jackson holds town hall with Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez.

item.title: What to know about the PHP bug affecting 70% of world's websites
item.description: AI was used to uncover a security weakness that affects most of the world's websites, researchers said. Here's what internet users should know.

item.title: Judge says Trump must sit for deposition in BBC defamation lawsuit
item.description: A federal judge said President Trump must sit for a deposition with lawyers for the BBC by Dec. 11 as part of his ongoing defamation lawsuit.

item.title: Trump says Venezuelan oil could replenish depleted U.S. stockpiles. Will it?
item.description: President Trump framed last week's deal for the U.S. government to take a stake in Venezuelan oil as a boon for the depleted Strategic Petroleum Reserve. But the plan faces some hurdles, experts say.
